objective: Design and validate a reusable Microsoft Copilot connection that uses EAI External ID, PublicAPI, Authz and ResourceAPI without bypassing tenant, authorization, audit or data controls.

modelTiers.simple: Use the repo model policy simple tier.
modelTiers.medium: Use the repo model policy medium tier.
modelTiers.hard: Use the repo model policy hard tier for identity, security, and architecture.
modelTiers.arbiter: Use the repo model policy arbiter tier only for contradictory security or release-critical results.

evalCommands.purpose: Verify the bounded research loop, decision gates, and evidence contract before specification.
evalCommands.runWhen: after research changes and before specification

evalCommands.purpose: Verify the reference architecture, requirements, use-case coverage and implementation decision gate.
evalCommands.runWhen: after specification changes and before implementation planning

successCriteria.description: Business owner selects the first journey, users, distribution model, identity model, and data posture.
The selected design keeps every EAI read and mutation behind PublicAPI and Authz.
A customer pilot proves tenant isolation, auditable actions, removal of access, and measurable cost.
Exactly 100 ranked use cases fit the reusable connection without direct downstream-service or database access.

stopConditions.description: Stop broad implementation until the dynamic-profile decision gate is approved.
Escalate after three failed validation loops or any unresolved security boundary.

humanEscalation.owner: business owner and platform security owner
escalateWhen: customer identity cannot be mapped safely to an EAI user and tenant
data must be indexed into Microsoft 365 without approved ACL and deletion controls
a preview Microsoft capability becomes production-critical
